derivation.spec_heading: 5A. The two entry paths and the document tab strip
derivation.reproducible: Re-running spec-derive-microtasks.py against an unchanged spec reproduces this contract with this same mt_id.

clause: The module entry swaps the whole viewport; the tab strip swaps the document
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: The module entry swaps the whole viewport; the tab strip swaps the document.** Two entry paths coexist and MUST NOT be collapsed into one: 1. **Whole-viewport switch.** Pressing the Studio entry in the module rail swaps the entire Handshake work area to Studio. Every other module keeps RUNNING with live state behind the swap; nothing is torn down, disposed or re-initialised, and switching back restores the previous module's live state rather than a reconstruction of it ([STU-SHL-005]). 2. **Document switch inside Studio.** Once Studio holds the viewport, the document tab strip and the centre tree switch between open documents ([STU-SHL-097]) without touching module state. A module switch MUST NOT rewrite, close, reorder or reset the Studio document set, and a document switch MUST NOT affect any other module.
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
